    73	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar = false } = {}) {
    74	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    75	
    76	  try {
    77	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    78	    StatusBar.setTranslucent(false);
    79	    StatusBar.setBackgroundColor(
    80	      dimStatusBar ? androidStatusBarDimmedColor : androidNavigationBarColor,
    81	      true,
    82	    );
    83	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    84	  } catch {}
    85	
    86	  try {
    87	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
    88	  } catch {}
    89	
    90	  try {
    91	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
    92	  } catch {}
    93	}
    94	
    95	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
    96	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
    97	
    98	  useEffect(() => {
    99	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
   100	
   101	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme({ dimStatusBar });
   102	
   103	    applyTheme();
   104	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
   105	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   106	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   107	      if (state === "active") {
   108	        applyTheme();
   109	      }
   110	    });
   111	    let visibilitySubscription;
   112	
   113	    try {
   114	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   115	        applyTheme,
   116	      );
   117	    } catch {}
   118	
   119	    return () => {
   120	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   121	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   122	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   123	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   124	    };
   125	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   126	
   127	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   128	    return null;
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  return (
   132	    <View
   133	      pointerEvents="none"
   134	      style={{
   135	        position: "absolute",
   136	        left: 0,
   137	        right: 0,
   138	        bottom: 0,
   139	        height: insets.bottom,
   140	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   141	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   142	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   143	        zIndex: 1000001,
   144	        elevation: 1000001,
   145	      }}
   146	    />
   147	  );
   148	}

   150	function AndroidStatusBarTint({ dimmed = false }) {
   151	  const height =
   152	    Platform.OS === "android" && Number.isFinite(StatusBar.currentHeight)
   153	      ? Math.max(0, StatusBar.currentHeight)
   154	      : 0;
   155	
   156	  if (height <= 0) {
   157	    return null;
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  return (
   161	    <View
   162	      pointerEvents="none"
   163	      style={{
   164	        position: "absolute",
   165	        top: 0,
   166	        left: 0,
   167	        right: 0,
   168	        height,
   169	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   170	        zIndex: 1000002,
   171	        elevation: 1000002,
   172	      }}
   173	    >
   174	      {dimmed ? (
   175	        <View
   176	          pointerEvents="none"
   177	          style={{
   178	            position: "absolute",
   179	            top: 0,
   180	            right: 0,
   181	            bottom: 0,
   182	            left: 0,
   183	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   184	          }}
   185	        />
   186	      ) : null}
   187	    </View>
   188	  );
   189	}

   234	function StartupQuestionSplash({ headerScrollY }) {
   235	  const [isDismissed, setIsDismissed] = useState(false);
   236	  const [showQuestionOverlay, setShowQuestionOverlay] = useState(false);
   237	  const questionOverlayOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   238	  const handleSplashComplete = useCallback(() => {
   239	    setIsDismissed(true);
   240	    router.replace("/");
   241	  }, []);
   242	
   243	  useEffect(() => {
   244	    const revealTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   245	      setShowQuestionOverlay(true);
   246	    }, startupSplashQuestionRevealDelay);
   247	
   248	    return () => {
   249	      clearTimeout(revealTimer);
   250	    };
   251	  }, []);
   252	
   253	  useEffect(() => {
   254	    if (!showQuestionOverlay) return;
   255	
   256	    questionOverlayOpacity.setValue(0);
   257	    Animated.timing(questionOverlayOpacity, {
   258	      toValue: 1,
   259	      duration: startupSplashQuestionRevealDuration,
   260	      useNativeDriver: true,
   261	    }).start();
   262	  }, [questionOverlayOpacity, showQuestionOverlay]);
   263	
   264	  if (isDismissed) {
   265	    return null;
   266	  }
   267	
   268	  return (
   269	    <View
   270	      style={{
   271	        position: "absolute",
   272	        top: 0,
   273	        right: 0,
   274	        bottom: 0,
   275	        left: 0,
   276	        zIndex: 2000000,
   277	        elevation: 2000000,
   278	      }}
   279	    >
   280	      <StartupOrangeBackground
   281	        style={{
   282	          position: "absolute",
   283	          top: 0,
   284	          right: 0,
   285	          bottom: 0,
   286	          left: 0,
   287	        }}
   288	      />
   289	      <StartupSplashLogo />
   290	      {showQuestionOverlay ? (
   291	        <Animated.View
   292	          style={{
   293	            position: "absolute",
   294	            top: 0,
   295	            right: 0,
   296	            bottom: 0,
   297	            left: 0,
   298	            zIndex: 1,
   299	            elevation: 1,
   300	            opacity: questionOverlayOpacity,
   301	          }}
   302	        >
   303	          <QuestionOverlay
   304	            headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   305	            onClose={handleSplashComplete}
   306	            presentation="splash"
   307	            visible
   308	          />
   309	        </Animated.View>
   310	      ) : null}
   311	    </View>
   312	  );
   313	}
   314	
   315	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY }) {
   316	  const pathname = usePathname();
   317	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   318	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   319	  const {
   320	    cartOverlayActionRequest,
   321	    isQuestionOverlayVisible,
   322	    isShopOverlayVisible,
   323	  } = useShopCart();
   324	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   325	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   326	
   327	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   328	
   329	  const useOverlayHeader =
   330	    pathname === "/" ||
   331	    pathname === "/products" ||
   332	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   333	    pathname === "/contact";
   334	
   335	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   336	    useOverlayHeader &&
   337	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   338	  const isShopQuestionOverlayVisible =
   339	    pathname === "/shop" && isQuestionOverlayVisible;
   340	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   341	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   342	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   343	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   344	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   345	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) &&
   346	    !isShopQuestionOverlayVisible;
   347	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   348	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   349	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   350	    Platform.OS === "android" &&
   351	    ((pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) ||
   352	      isShopQuestionOverlayVisible);
   353	
   354	  return (
   355	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   356	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   357	        <View
   358	          pointerEvents="none"
   359	          style={{
   360	            position: "absolute",
   361	            top: 0,
   362	            left: 0,
   363	            right: 0,
   364	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   365	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   366	          }}
   367	        >
   368	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   369	        </View>
   370	      ) : null}
   371	
   372	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   373	        <Stack
   374	          screenOptions={{
   375	            headerShown: false,
   376	            animation: "none",
   377	            contentStyle: {
   378	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   379	                ? "transparent"
   380	                : "#FFFCF2",
   381	            },
   382	          }}
   383	        />
   384	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   385	
   386	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   387	        <ScreenFade
   388	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   389	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   390	        />
   391	      ) : null}
   392	
   393	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   394	        <View
   395	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   396	          style={{
   397	            position: "absolute",
   398	            top: 0,
   399	            left: 0,
   400	            right: 0,
   401	            zIndex: 1000000,
   402	            elevation: 1000000,
   403	          }}
   404	        >
   405	          <AppHeader
   406	            dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   407	            scrollY={headerScrollY}
   408	            showHero={false}
   409	          />
   410	        </View>
   411	      ) : null}
   412	
   413	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   414	        <AppHeader
   415	          dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   416	          scrollY={headerScrollY}
   417	        />
   418	      ) : null}
   419	
   420	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   421	        <View
   422	          pointerEvents="none"
   423	          style={{
   424	            position: "absolute",
   425	            top: 0,
   426	            right: 0,
   427	            bottom: 0,
   428	            left: 0,
   429	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   430	            zIndex: 1000001,
   431	            elevation: 1000001,
   432	          }}
   433	        />
   434	      ) : null}
   435	
   436	      <StickyCartButton />
   437	
   438	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   439	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   440	      />
   441	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   442	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   443	        pathname={pathname}
   444	      />
   445	      <StartupQuestionSplash headerScrollY={headerScrollY} />
   446	    </View>
   447	  );
   448	}
   449	
   450	export default function RootLayout() {
   451	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   452	
   453	  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
   454	    "Dream Avenue": require("../assets/fonts/dream_avenue/dream_avenue.ttf"),
   455	    "Great Vibes": require("../assets/fonts/great_vibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf"),
   456	    "TT Fors": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_regular.ttf"),

   458	    "TT Fors Black": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_black.ttf"),
   459	    "TT Fors Light": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_light.ttf"),
   460	  });
   461	
   462	  if (!fontsLoaded) {
   463	    return <StartupOrangeBackground />;

    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );
    37	}

    39	export default function HomeScreen() {
    40	  const [imageLayouts, setImageLayouts] = useState({});
    41	  const [paragraphLayouts, setParagraphLayouts] = useState({});
    42	  const {
    43	    compactTopLayout,

    55	    inputRange: [0, passionImageBlendScrollDistance],

    68	          }

    71	            ...currentLayouts,

    78	  const handleImageLayout = useCallback(
    79	    (featureName) =>

   161	              {section.note ? (
   162	                <Text style={productsStyles.includeNote}>{section.note}</Text>
   163	              ) : null}
   164	            </View>
   165	          ))}
   166	        </View>
   167	
   168	        <Pressable
   169	          accessibilityLabel={`Buy ${product.title}`}
   170	          accessibilityRole="button"
   171	          onLayout={onBuyButtonLayout}
   172	          onPress={onBuyPress}
   173	          style={({ pressed }) => [
   174	            productsStyles.buyButton,
   175	            pressed && productsStyles.buyButtonPressed,
   176	          ]}
   177	        >
   178	          <ProductOrangeButtonGradient />
   179	          <Text
   180	            adjustsFontSizeToFit
   181	            allowFontScaling={false}
   182	            minimumFontScale={0.72}
   183	            numberOfLines={1}
   184	            style={productsStyles.buyButtonText}
   185	          >
   186	            {`Buy ${product.title}`}
   187	          </Text>
   188	        </Pressable>
   189	      </View>
   190	    </View>
   191	  );
   192	}
   193	
   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}
   233	
   234	export default function ProductsScreen() {
   235	  const {
   236	    compactTopLayout,
   237	    initialContentOffset,
   238	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
   239	    scrollHandlers,
   240	    scrollY,
   241	  } =
   242	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
   243	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
   244	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
   245	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
   246	  const openProductInShop = (productTitle) => {
   247	    router.push({
   248	      pathname: "/shop",
   249	      params: {
   250	        openProduct: String(Date.now()),
   251	        product: productTitle,
   252	      },
   253	    });
   254	  };
   255	
   256	  return (
   257	    <View style={productsStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   258	      <Animated.ScrollView
   259	        style={productsStyles.scroll}
   260	        contentContainerStyle={[
   261	          productsStyles.scrollContent,
   262	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   263	        ]}
   264	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   265	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   266	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   267	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   268	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   269	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   270	        {...scrollHandlers}
   271	      >
   272	        <View style={productsStyles.main}>
   273	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   274	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   275	            pageTitleStyle={productsStyles.pageTitle}
   276	            scrollY={scrollY}
   277	          />
   278	
   279	          {products.map((product, index) => (
   280	            <Fragment key={product.title}>
   281	              <ProductMagnifySection
   282	                croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   283	                onBuyPress={() => openProductInShop(product.title)}
   284	                product={product}
   285	                scrollY={scrollY}
   286	              />
   287	              {index < products.length - 1 ? <PageDivider /> : null}
   288	            </Fragment>
   289	          ))}
   290	        </View>
   291	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   292	    </View>
   293	  );
   294	}

    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5

FILE: mob/app/contact.js

     1	import { useState } from "react";
     2	import { Alert, Animated, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	import CenterMagnifyView from "../components/CenterMagnifyView";
     5	import HapticPressable from "../components/HapticPressable";
     6	import MainScreenIntroSpacer from "../components/MainScreenIntroSpacer";
     7	import contactStyles from "../styles/contactStyles";
     8	import { sendContactMessage } from "../utils/contactMessages";
     9	import { useMainScreenScrollProps } from "../utils/mainScreenScrollContext";
    10	import { getMainScreenScrollViewProps } from "../utils/platformLayout";
    11	import useMainScreenSwipeNavigation from "../utils/useMainScreenSwipeNavigation";
    12	
    13	export default function ContactScreen() {
    14	  const [name, setName] = useState("");
    15	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    16	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
    17	  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    18	  const [emptyTouchedFieldKeys, setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys] = useState({});
    19	  const [blurredFieldKeys, setBlurredFieldKeys] = useState({});
    20	  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    21	  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState("");
    22	  const {
    23	    compactTopLayout,
    24	    initialContentOffset,
    25	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    26	    scrollHandlers,
    27	    scrollY,
    28	  } =
    29	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    30	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    31	  const trimmedName = name.trim();
    32	  const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    33	  const trimmedMessage = message.trim();
    34	  const isEmailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail);
    35	  const canSubmit =
    36	    trimmedName.length > 0 &&
    37	    isEmailValid &&
    38	    trimmedMessage.length > 0 &&
    39	    !isSending;
    40	
    41	  const contactFieldValues = {
    42	    email,
    43	    message,
    44	    name,
    45	    phone,
    46	  };
    47	  const shouldShowFieldFault = (fieldKey) =>
    48	    Boolean(emptyTouchedFieldKeys[fieldKey]) ||
    49	    (fieldKey === "email" &&
    50	      Boolean(blurredFieldKeys.email) &&
    51	      trimmedEmail.length > 0 &&
    52	      !isEmailValid);
    53	
    54	  const clearFieldFault = (fieldKey) => {
    55	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    56	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    57	        return currentFieldKeys;
    58	      }
    59	
    60	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    61	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    62	      return nextFieldKeys;
    63	    });
    64	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    65	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    66	        return currentFieldKeys;
    67	      }
    68	
    69	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    70	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    71	      return nextFieldKeys;
    72	    });
    73	  };
    74	
    75	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    76	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    77	
    78	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    79	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    80	      [fieldKey]: true,
    81	    }));
    82	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    83	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    84	
    85	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    86	        return {
    87	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    88	          [fieldKey]: true,
    89	        };
    90	      }
    91	
    92	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    93	        return currentFieldKeys;
    94	      }
    95	
    96	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    97	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    98	      return nextFieldKeys;
    99	    });
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   103	    setter(text);
   104	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   105	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   106	        return currentFieldKeys;
   107	      }
   108	
   109	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   110	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   111	      return nextFieldKeys;
   112	    });
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   116	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   117	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   118	      return;
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   122	  };
   123	
   124	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   125	    if (!canSubmit) {
   126	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   127	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   128	        email: true,
   129	      }));
   130	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   131	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   132	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   133	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   134	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   135	      }));
   136	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   137	      return;
   138	    }
   139	
   140	    setIsSending(true);
   141	    setStatusMessage("");
   142	
   143	    try {
   144	      await sendContactMessage({
   145	        email: trimmedEmail,
   146	        message: trimmedMessage,
   147	        name: trimmedName,
   148	        phone: phone.trim(),
   149	      });
   150	      setName("");
   151	      setEmail("");
   152	      setPhone("");
   153	      setMessage("");
   154	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   155	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   156	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   157	      showContactAlert(
   158	        "Message sent",
   159	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   160	      );
   161	    } catch (error) {
   162	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   163	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   164	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   165	    } finally {
   166	      setIsSending(false);
   167	    }
   168	  };
   169	
   170	  return (
   171	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   172	      <Animated.ScrollView
   173	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   174	        contentContainerStyle={[
   175	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   176	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   177	        ]}
   178	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   179	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   180	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   181	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   182	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   183	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   184	        {...scrollHandlers}
   185	      >
   186	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   187	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   188	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   189	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   190	            scrollY={scrollY}
   191	          />
   192	
   193	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   194	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   195	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   196	              General questions about our products?
   197	            </Text>
   198	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   199	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   200	            </Text>
   201	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   202	
   203	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   204	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   205	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   206	              <TextInput
   207	                style={[
   208	                  contactStyles.input,
   209	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   210	                ]}
   211	                placeholder="Your Name"
   212	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   213	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   214	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   215	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   216	                returnKeyType="next"
   217	                textContentType="name"
   218	                value={name}
   219	              />
   220	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   221	
   222	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   223	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   224	              <TextInput
   225	                style={[
   226	                  contactStyles.input,
   227	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   228	                ]}
   229	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   230	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   231	                keyboardType="email-address"
   232	                autoCapitalize="none"
   233	                autoCorrect={false}
   234	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   235	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   236	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   237	                }
   238	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   239	                returnKeyType="next"
   240	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   241	                value={email}
   242	              />
   243	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   244	
   245	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   246	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   247	              <TextInput
   248	                style={[
   249	                  contactStyles.input,
   250	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   251	                ]}
   252	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   253	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   254	                keyboardType="phone-pad"
   255	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("phone")}
   256	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   257	                  updateContactField("phone", text, setPhone)
   258	                }
   259	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("phone")}
   260	                returnKeyType="next"
   261	                textContentType="telephoneNumber"
   262	                value={phone}
   263	              />
   264	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   265	
   266	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   267	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Your Message</Text>
   268	              <TextInput
   269	                style={[
   270	                  contactStyles.input,
   271	                  contactStyles.messageInput,
   272	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   273	                ]}
   274	                placeholder="Your Message"
   275	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   276	                multiline
   277	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   278	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   279	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   280	                }
   281	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   282	                returnKeyType="default"
   283	                textAlignVertical="top"
   284	                value={message}
   285	              />
   286	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   287	
   288	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY} style={contactStyles.buttonWrap}>
   289	              <HapticPressable
   290	                accessibilityRole="button"
   291	                disabled={isSending}
   292	                onPress={handleSubmit}
   293	                style={({ pressed }) => [
   294	                  contactStyles.button,
   295	                  (!canSubmit || pressed) && contactStyles.buttonDimmed,
   296	                ]}
   297	              >
   298	                <Text style={contactStyles.buttonText}>
   299	                  {isSending ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
   300	                </Text>
   301	              </HapticPressable>
   302	              {statusMessage ? (
   303	                <Text style={contactStyles.statusText}>{statusMessage}</Text>
   304	              ) : null}
   305	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   306	          </View>
   307	        </View>
   308	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   309	    </View>
   310	  );
   311	}

   902	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {
   903	  const strokeInset = piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth / 2;
   904	  const strokeColor = muted ? "#888888" : "#111111";
   905	  const isUpTriangle = direction === "up";
   906	  const fillGradientId = isUpTriangle
   907	    ? "piccolaQuantityTriangleTopGradient"
   908	    : "piccolaQuantityTriangleBottomGradient";
   909	  const fillGradientColors = isUpTriangle
   910	    ? topOverlayGradientColors
   911	    : orangeButtonGradientColors;
   912	  const path =
   913	    isUpTriangle
   914	      ? [
   915	          `M ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${strokeInset}`,
   916	          `L ${
   917	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   918	          } ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset}`,
   919	          `L ${strokeInset} ${
   920	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   921	          }`,
   922	          "Z",
   923	        ].join(" ")
   924	      : [
   925	          `M ${strokeInset} ${strokeInset}`,
   926	          `L ${
   927	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
   928	          } ${strokeInset}`,
   929	          `L ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${
   930	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
   931	          }`,
   932	          "Z",
   933	        ].join(" ");
   934	
   935	  return (
   936	    <Svg
   937	      height="100%"
   938	      style={shopStyles.piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleSvg}
   939	      viewBox={`0 0 ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth} ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}`}
   940	      width="100%"
   941	    >
   942	      <Defs>
   943	        <SvgLinearGradient
   944	          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
   945	          id={fillGradientId}
   946	          x1={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   947	          x2={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
   948	          y1={isUpTriangle ? piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight : 0}
   949	          y2={isUpTriangle ? 0 : piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}
   950	        >
   951	          {fillGradientColors.map((color, index) => (
   952	            <Stop
   953	              key={`${fillGradientId}-${color}`}
   954	              offset={`${index * 50}%`}
   955	              stopColor={color}
   956	            />
   957	          ))}
   958	        </SvgLinearGradient>
   959	      </Defs>
   960	      <Path
   961	        d={path}
   962	        fill={`url(#${fillGradientId})`}
   963	        opacity={muted ? 0.5 : 1}
   964	        stroke={strokeColor}
   965	        strokeLinejoin="round"
   966	        strokeWidth={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth}
   967	      />
   968	    </Svg>
   969	  );
   970	}

  2582	      typeof startX !== "number" ||
  2583	      typeof startY !== "number" ||
  2584	      typeof currentX !== "number" ||
  2585	      typeof currentY !== "number"
  2586	    ) {
  2587	      return;

  2589	
  2590	    const dx = currentX - startX;
  2591	    const dy = Math.abs(currentY - startY);
  2592	    const minimumHorizontalSwipeDistance = 12.5;
  2593	    const horizontalDominanceRatio = 0.4375;
  2594	    const isHorizontalSwipeIntent =
  2595	      Math.abs(dx) >= minimumHorizontalSwipeDistance &&

  3842	  const handleOrderConfirmationYesPress = async () => {
  3843	    if (isStripePaymentInFlight) return;
  3844	
  3845	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
  3846	      showPaymentAlert(
  3847	        "Payment unavailable",
  3848	        "Stripe payments are available in the mobile app build.",
  3849	      );
  3850	      return;
  3851	    }
  3852	
  3853	    const configurationIssue = getStripeConfigurationIssue();
  3854	
  3855	    if (configurationIssue) {
  3856	      showPaymentAlert("Stripe setup needed", configurationIssue);
  3857	      return;
  3858	    }
  3859	
  3860	    if (
  3861	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayCardMethod &&
  3862	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod &&
  3863	      selectedPaymentOverlayMethod !== paymentOverlayApplePayMethod
  3864	    ) {
  3865	      showPaymentAlert(
  3866	        "Payment method unavailable",
  3867	        "Use Debit/Credit Card, Google Pay, or Apple Pay for this Stripe checkout.",
  3868	      );
  3869	      return;
  3870	    }
  3871	
  3872	    if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayApplePayMethod) {
  3873	      if (Platform.OS !== "ios") {
  3874	        showPaymentAlert(
  3875	          "Apple Pay unavailable",
  3876	          "Apple Pay is only available on iPhone. Use Debit/Credit Card or Google Pay on this device.",
  3877	        );
  3878	        return;
  3879	      }
  3880	
  3881	      if (isExpoGo) {
  3882	        showPaymentAlert(
  3883	          "Apple Pay needs a development build",
  3884	          "Expo Go cannot open the native Apple Pay sheet. Use an iOS development build or App Store build to test Apple Pay.",
  3885	        );
  3886	        return;
  3887	      }
  3888	
  3889	      if (!stripeMerchantIdentifier) {
  3890	        showPaymentAlert(
  3891	          "Apple Pay setup needed",
  3892	          "Add EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_MERCHANT_IDENTIFIER to mob/.env so StripeProvider can use your Apple merchant ID.",
  3893	        );
  3894	        return;
  3895	      }
  3896	
  3897	      if (!isApplePaySupported) {
  3898	        showPaymentAlert(
  3899	          "Apple Pay unavailable",
  3900	          "This iPhone is not ready for Apple Pay. Make sure Wallet has an active card, then try again.",
  3901	        );
  3902	        return;
  3903	      }
  3904	    } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {
  3905	      if (Platform.OS !== "android") {
  3906	        showPaymentAlert(
  3907	          "Google Pay unavailable",
  3908	          "Google Pay is only available on Android. Use Debit/Credit Card on this device.",
  3909	        );
  3910	        return;
  3911	      }
  3912	
  3913	      if (isExpoGo) {
  3914	        showPaymentAlert(
  3915	          "Google Pay needs a development build",
  3916	          "Expo Go cannot open the native Google Pay sheet. Use an Android development build or Play Store build to test Google Pay.",
  3917	        );
  3918	        return;
  3919	      }
  3920	
  3921	      if (!isGooglePaySupported) {
  3922	        showPaymentAlert(
  3923	          "Google Pay unavailable",
  3924	          "This device is not ready for Google Pay. Make sure Google Wallet is set up, then try again.",
  3925	        );
  3926	        return;
  3927	      }
  3928	    } else if (
  3929	      !isPaymentCardAccepted ||
  3930	      !stripeCardDetails?.complete ||
  3931	      !acceptedStripePaymentMethodId
  3932	    ) {
  3933	      showPaymentAlert(
  3934	        "Card details needed",
  3935	        "Enter a complete card number, expiration date, and CVV.",
  3936	      );
  3937	      return;
  3938	    }
  3939	
  3940	    const orderPayload = buildStripeOrderPayload();
  3941	
  3942	    if (orderPayload.items.length === 0) {
  3943	      showPaymentAlert("Cart is empty", "Add an item before placing an order.");
  3944	      return;
  3945	    }
  3946	
  3947	    setIsStripePaymentInFlight(true);
  3948	
  3949	    try {
  3950	      const paymentSheet = await createStripePaymentSheet(orderPayload);
  3951	      if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayApplePayMethod) {
  3952	        await confirmApplePayPayment(
  3953	          paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret,
  3954	          paymentSheet,
  3955	        );
  3956	      } else if (selectedPaymentOverlayMethod === paymentOverlayGooglePayMethod) {
  3957	        await confirmGooglePayPayment(paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret);
  3958	      } else {
  3959	        const confirmResult = await confirmPayment(
  3960	          paymentSheet.paymentIntentClientSecret,
  3961	          {
  3962	            paymentMethodType: "Card",
  3963	            paymentMethodData: {
  3964	              billingDetails: buildStripeBillingDetails(),
  3965	              paymentMethodId: acceptedStripePaymentMethodId,
  3966	            },
  3967	          },
  3968	        );
  3969	
  3970	        if (confirmResult.error) {
  3971	          throw new Error(

    63	  (heroFullScrollTranslateY - heroStartTranslateY) * heroScrollFreezeProgress;
    64	const carouselBaseHeight = 84;
    65	const carouselExpandedHeight = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 104 : 84;
    66	const carouselExpansionHeight = carouselExpandedHeight - carouselBaseHeight;
    67	const carouselStickyOffsetY = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0 : 20;
    68	const stickyExpansionMaxHeight = Math.max(
    69	  carouselExpansionHeight,
    70	  carouselStickyOffsetY
    71	);
    72	const tapHoldHorizontalCancelDistance = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 11 : 4;
    73	const tapHoldHorizontalDominanceRatio = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 1.08 : 0.7;
    74	const carouselSwipeActivationDistance = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 20 : 8;
    75	const carouselSwipeActivationRatio = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 1.5 : 1.05;
    76	const carouselSwipeCommitDistance = Platform.OS === "ios" ? 60 : 28;
    77	
    78	const pageLabels = {
    79	  home: "Home",
    80	  products: "Products",
    81	  aboutus: "About Us",
    82	  contact: "Contact",
    83	  shop: "Shop",
    84	};
    85	
    86	const pageRoutes = {
    87	  home: "/",
    88	  products: "/products",
    89	  aboutus: "/aboutus",
    90	  contact: "/contact",
    91	  shop: "/shop",
    92	};
    93	
    94	function getActivePageFromPath(pathname) {
    95	  if (pathname === "/products") return "products";
    96	  if (pathname === "/aboutus") return "aboutus";
    97	  if (pathname === "/contact") return "contact";
    98	  if (pathname === "/shop") return "shop";
    99	  return "home";
   100	}
   101	
   102	function getNavigationDirection(fromPage, toPage) {
   103	  const fromIndex = navPages.indexOf(fromPage);
   104	  const toIndex = navPages.indexOf(toPage);
   105	
   106	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex === toIndex) return 1;
   107	
   108	  const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   109	
   110	  if (fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0) return 1;
   111	  if (fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex) return -1;
   112	
   113	  return toIndex > fromIndex ? 1 : -1;
   114	}
   115	
   116	export default function AppHeader({
   117	  activePage,
   118	  dimHeaderExceptShopButton = false,
   119	  scrollY,
   120	  showCarousel = true,
   121	  showHero = true,
   122	  showOnlyCarousel = false,
   123	  showOnlyHero = false,
   124	}) {
   125	  const pathname = usePathname();
   126	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   127	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   128	  const resolvedActivePage = activePage || getActivePageFromPath(pathname);
   129	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
   130	  const activePageIndex = Math.max(navPages.indexOf(resolvedActivePage), 0);
   131	  const handlesCarouselVisuals = showCarousel && !showOnlyHero;
   132	
   133	  const fallbackScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   134	  const safeScrollY = scrollY || fallbackScrollY;
   135	  const canNavigateWithHeader = useHeaderNavigationGate(safeScrollY);
   136	  const heroStateScrollY =
   137	    showHero && backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen && backgroundHeroState?.heroScrollY
   138	      ? backgroundHeroState.heroScrollY
   139	      : safeScrollY;
   140	  const headerMotionScrollY = showOnlyHero ? heroStateScrollY : safeScrollY;
   141	  const frozenHeroMotionScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   142	  const frozenHeaderMotionScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   143	  const shouldFreezeHeaderMotion = Boolean(
   144	    screenSwipe?.isActive || screenSwipe?.routeTransitionState?.isActive
   145	  );
   146	  const previousShouldFreezeHeaderMotionRef = useRef(false);
   147	
   148	  useEffect(() => {
   149	    if (
   150	      shouldFreezeHeaderMotion &&
   151	      !previousShouldFreezeHeaderMotionRef.current
   152	    ) {
   153	      frozenHeroMotionScrollY.setValue(readAnimatedValue(heroStateScrollY));
   154	      frozenHeaderMotionScrollY.setValue(readAnimatedValue(headerMotionScrollY));
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    previousShouldFreezeHeaderMotionRef.current = shouldFreezeHeaderMotion;
   158	  }, [
   159	    frozenHeroMotionScrollY,
   160	    frozenHeaderMotionScrollY,
   161	    headerMotionScrollY,
   162	    heroStateScrollY,
   163	    shouldFreezeHeaderMotion,
   164	  ]);
   165	
   166	  const resolvedHeroMotionScrollY = shouldFreezeHeaderMotion
   167	    ? frozenHeroMotionScrollY
   168	    : heroStateScrollY;
   169	  const resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY = shouldFreezeHeaderMotion
   170	    ? frozenHeaderMotionScrollY
   171	    : headerMotionScrollY;
   172	
   173	  const fallbackHeldArrowOpacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   174	  const fallbackRouteTransitionProgress = useRef(
   175	    new Animated.Value(0)
   176	  ).current;
   177	  const heldArrowOpacity =
   178	    screenSwipe?.heldArrowOpacity || fallbackHeldArrowOpacity;
   179	  const routeTransitionProgress =
   180	    screenSwipe?.routeTransitionProgress || fallbackRouteTransitionProgress;
   181	  const indicatorProgress = useRef(new Animated.Value(activePageIndex)).current;
   182	  const fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity = useRef(
   183	    new Animated.Value(0)
   184	  ).current;
   185	  const fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity = useRef(
   186	    new Animated.Value(0)
   187	  ).current;
   188	  const fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression = useRef(
   189	    new Animated.Value(0)
   190	  ).current;
   191	  const directionalLeftArrowOpacity =
   192	    screenSwipe?.directionalLeftArrowOpacity ||
   193	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity;
   194	  const directionalRightArrowOpacity =
   195	    screenSwipe?.directionalRightArrowOpacity ||
   196	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity;
   197	  const directionalArrowBaseSuppression =
   198	    screenSwipe?.directionalArrowBaseSuppression ||
   199	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression;
   200	
   201	  const indicatorAnimationRef = useRef(null);
   202	  const indicatorIndexRef = useRef(activePageIndex);
   203	  const suppressCarouselPressUntilRef = useRef(0);
   204	  const canNavigateWithHeaderRef = useRef(canNavigateWithHeader);
   205	
   206	  const activePageRef = useRef(resolvedActivePage);
   207	  const activeIndexRef = useRef(activePageIndex);
   208	  canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current = canNavigateWithHeader;
   209	  activePageRef.current = resolvedActivePage;
   210	  activeIndexRef.current = activePageIndex;
   211	
   212	  useEffect(() => {
   213	    if (Platform.OS !== "ios") return;
   214	
   215	    const resolvedCheeseboardImage = Image.resolveAssetSource(
   216	      cheeseboardProductsImage
   217	    );
   218	
   219	    if (resolvedCheeseboardImage?.uri) {
   220	      Image.prefetch(resolvedCheeseboardImage.uri).catch(() => {});
   221	    }
   222	  }, []);
   223	
   224	  const showHeldArrows = (event = null) => {
   225	    if (screenSwipe?.showHeldArrowHint) {
   226	      screenSwipe.showHeldArrowHint(event);
   227	      return;
   228	    }
   229	
   230	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   231	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(arrowHintPeakOpacity);
   232	  };
   233	
   234	  const hideHeldArrows = () => {
   235	    if (screenSwipe?.hideHeldArrowHint) {
   236	      screenSwipe.hideHeldArrowHint();
   237	      return;
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   241	    fallbackHeldArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   242	  };
   243	
   244	  const cancelHeldArrows = () => {
   245	    if (screenSwipe?.cancelHeldArrowHint) {
   246	      screenSwipe.cancelHeldArrowHint();
   247	      return;
   248	    }
   249	
   250	    hideHeldArrows();
   251	  };
   252	
   253	  const updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove = (event) => {
   254	    screenSwipe?.updateHeldArrowHintMovement?.(event);
   255	    return false;
   256	  };
   257	
   258	  const clearDirectionalArrowLinger = () => {
   259	    if (screenSwipe?.clearDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   260	      screenSwipe.clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   261	      return;
   262	    }
   263	
   264	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   265	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   266	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   267	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   268	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(0);
   269	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(0);
   270	  };
   271	
   272	  const startDirectionalArrowLinger = (direction) => {
   273	    if (screenSwipe?.startDirectionalArrowLinger) {
   274	      screenSwipe.startDirectionalArrowLinger(direction);
   275	      return;
   276	    }
   277	
   278	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   279	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.stopAnimation();
   280	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.stopAnimation();
   281	    fallbackDirectionalArrowBaseSuppression.setValue(1);
   282	    fallbackDirectionalLeftArrowOpacity.setValue(
   283	      direction === "left" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0
   284	    );
   285	    fallbackDirectionalRightArrowOpacity.setValue(
   286	      direction === "right" ? arrowHintPeakOpacity : 0
   287	    );
   288	  };
   289	
   290	  const updateSwipePreview = (dragDistance) => {
   291	    if (!screenSwipe) return;
   292	
   293	    screenSwipe.updateSwipe({
   294	      x: dragDistance,
   295	    });
   296	  };
   297	
   298	  const animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes = (fromIndex, toIndex) => {
   299	    if (fromIndex === toIndex) {
   300	      if (!indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   301	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   302	      }
   303	      return;
   304	    }
   305	
   306	    if (indicatorAnimationRef.current) {
   307	      const previousAnimation = indicatorAnimationRef.current;
   308	      indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   309	      previousAnimation.stop();
   310	    }
   311	
   312	    indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   313	
   314	    const createIndicatorTiming = (toValue, duration = indicatorSlideDuration) =>
   315	      Animated.timing(indicatorProgress, {
   316	        toValue,
   317	        duration,
   318	        useNativeDriver: true,
   319	      });
   320	
   321	    const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   322	    const animation =
   323	      fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0
   324	        ? Animated.sequence([
   325	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length),
   326	            createIndicatorTiming(-1, 0),
   327	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   328	          ])
   329	        : fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex
   330	        ? Animated.sequence([
   331	            createIndicatorTiming(-1),
   332	            createIndicatorTiming(navPages.length, 0),
   333	            createIndicatorTiming(toIndex),
   334	          ])
   335	        : createIndicatorTiming(toIndex);
   336	
   337	    indicatorAnimationRef.current = animation;
   338	
   339	    animation.start(({ finished }) => {
   340	      if (finished) {
   341	        indicatorIndexRef.current = toIndex;
   342	      }
   343	
   344	      if (indicatorAnimationRef.current === animation) {
   345	        indicatorAnimationRef.current = null;
   346	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   347	      }
   348	    });
   349	  };
   350	
   351	  useEffect(() => {
   352	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(indicatorIndexRef.current, activePageIndex);
   353	  }, [activePageIndex, indicatorProgress]);
   354	
   355	  const animateIndicatorToPage = (pageName) => {
   356	    const pageIndex = navPages.indexOf(pageName);
   357	    if (pageIndex < 0) return;
   358	
   359	    animateIndicatorBetweenIndexes(activeIndexRef.current, pageIndex);
   360	  };
   361	
   362	  const goToPage = (pageName, animateIndicator = true) => {
   363	    hideHeldArrows();
   364	
   365	    if (pageName === activePageRef.current) {
   366	      if (pageName === "shop") {
   367	        goToPage("home", animateIndicator);
   368	      }
   369	
   370	      return;
   371	    }
   372	
   373	    const route = pageRoutes[pageName];
   374	    if (!route) return;
   375	
   376	    if (navPages.includes(pageName)) {
   377	      if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   378	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   379	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   380	        return;
   381	      }
   382	
   383	      backgroundHeroState?.freezeHero(safeScrollY);
   384	      if (animateIndicator) animateIndicatorToPage(pageName);
   385	      router.replace(route);
   386	      return;
   387	    }
   388	
   389	    router.push(route);
   390	  };
   391	
   392	  const goToPreviousPage = () => {
   393	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   394	
   395	    const previousIndex =
   396	      (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   397	
   398	    goToPage(navPages[previousIndex], true, -1);
   399	  };
   400	
   401	  const goToNextPage = () => {
   402	    if (Date.now() < suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current) return;
   403	
   404	    const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   405	
   406	    goToPage(navPages[nextIndex], true, 1);
   407	  };
   408	
   409	  const shouldClaimCarouselSwipe = (_, gestureState) => {
   410	    if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return false;
   411	
   412	    const horizontalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dx);
   413	    const verticalDistance = Math.abs(gestureState.dy);
   414	
   415	    if (
   416	      horizontalDistance >= tapHoldHorizontalCancelDistance &&
   417	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * tapHoldHorizontalDominanceRatio
   418	    ) {
   419	      cancelHeldArrows();
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    const shouldClaim =
   423	      horizontalDistance > carouselSwipeActivationDistance &&
   424	      horizontalDistance > verticalDistance * carouselSwipeActivationRatio;
   425	
   426	    if (shouldClaim) {
   427	      cancelHeldArrows();
   428	    }
   429	
   430	    return shouldClaim;
   431	  };
   432	
   433	  const carouselPanResponder = useRef(
   434	    PanResponder.create({
   435	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponder: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   436	
   437	      onMoveShouldSetPanResponderCapture: shouldClaimCarouselSwipe,
   438	
   439	      onPanResponderTerminationRequest: (_, gestureState) =>
   440	        !shouldClaimCarouselSwipe(null, gestureState),
   441	
   442	      onPanResponderMove: (_, gestureState) => {
   443	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) return;
   444	
   445	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   446	        updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   447	
   448	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   449	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   450	          return;
   451	        }
   452	
   453	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   454	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   455	          return;
   456	        }
   457	
   458	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   459	      },
   460	
   461	      onPanResponderRelease: (_, gestureState) => {
   462	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   463	        hideHeldArrows();
   464	
   465	        if (!canNavigateWithHeaderRef.current?.()) {
   466	          clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   467	          screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   468	          return;
   469	        }
   470	
   471	        if (gestureState.dx <= -carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   472	          const nextIndex = (activeIndexRef.current + 1) % navPages.length;
   473	          const nextPage = navPages[nextIndex];
   474	
   475	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   476	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   477	            x: gestureState.dx,
   478	            page: nextPage,
   479	            direction: 1,
   480	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   481	          });
   482	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("left");
   483	          goToPage(nextPage, true, 1);
   484	
   485	          return;
   486	        }
   487	
   488	        if (gestureState.dx >= carouselSwipeCommitDistance) {
   489	          const previousIndex =
   490	            (activeIndexRef.current + navPages.length - 1) % navPages.length;
   491	          const previousPage = navPages[previousIndex];
   492	
   493	          updateSwipePreview(gestureState.dx);
   494	          screenSwipe?.commitSwipe({
   495	            x: gestureState.dx,
   496	            page: previousPage,
   497	            direction: -1,
   498	            fromPage: activePageRef.current,
   499	          });
   500	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   501	          goToPage(previousPage, true, -1);
   502	
   503	          return;
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   507	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   508	      },
   509	
   510	      onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
   511	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   512	        hideHeldArrows();
   513	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   514	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   515	      },
   516	
   517	      onShouldBlockNativeResponder: () => true,
   518	    })
   519	  ).current;
   520	
   521	  useEffect(() => {
   522	    hideHeldArrows();
   523	
   524	    return () => {
   525	      hideHeldArrows();
   526	    };
   527	  }, [resolvedActivePage, showCarousel, showOnlyHero]);
   528	
   529	  useEffect(
   530	    () => () => {
   531	      clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   532	    },
   533	    []
   534	  );
   535	
   536	  const activeLink = pageLabels[resolvedActivePage] || "Home";
   537	  const arrowLinkTranslateX = 0;
   538	
   539	  const scrollBeganArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   540	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   541	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   542	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   543	  });
   544	  const oldHeaderArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   545	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   546	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   547	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   548	  });
   549	  const oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   550	    heldArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   551	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   552	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   553	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   554	    }),
   555	    oldHeaderArrowVisibility
   556	  );
   557	  const scrolledStateArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   558	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility,
   559	    arrowHintPeakOpacity
   560	  );
   561	  const scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   562	    heldArrowOpacity,
   563	    scrolledStateArrowOpacity
   564	  );
   565	  const gatedScrolledArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   566	    scrolledVisibleArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   567	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   568	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   569	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   570	    }),
   571	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility
   572	  );
   573	  const gatedVisibleArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   574	    oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity,
   575	    gatedScrolledArrowOpacity
   576	  ).interpolate({
   577	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   578	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   579	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   580	  });
   581	  const directionalBaseArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   582	    gatedVisibleArrowOpacity,
   583	    directionalArrowBaseSuppression.interpolate({
   584	      inputRange: [0, 1],
   585	      outputRange: [1, 0],
   586	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   587	    })
   588	  );
   589	  const leftArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   590	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   591	    directionalLeftArrowOpacity
   592	  ).interpolate({
   593	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   594	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   595	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   596	  });
   597	  const rightArrowOpacity = Animated.add(
   598	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   599	    directionalRightArrowOpacity
   600	  ).interpolate({
   601	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   602	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   603	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   604	  });
   605	
   606	  const heroVerticalFadeTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   607	    inputRange: [0, heroVerticalFadeScrollDistance],
   608	    outputRange: [heroVerticalFadeHeight, -heroVerticalFadeFeatherHeight],
   609	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   610	  });
   611	
   612	  const stickyOffset =
   613	    Platform.OS === "web"
   614	      ? 0
   615	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   616	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   617	          outputRange: [0, carouselStickyOffsetY],
   618	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   619	        });
   620	  const carouselExpansionOffsetY =
   621	    Platform.OS === "ios"
   622	      ? resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   623	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   624	          outputRange: [0, carouselExpansionHeight],
   625	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   626	        })
   627	      : stickyOffset;
   628	  const carouselInnerTranslateY = carouselExpansionOffsetY;
   629	  const centerShadowOpacity =
   630	    Platform.OS === "web"
   631	      ? 1
   632	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   633	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   634	          outputRange: [0, 1],
   635	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   636	        });
   637	
   638	  const stickyExpansionTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   639	    inputRange: [96, 120],
   640	    outputRange: [-stickyExpansionMaxHeight, 0],
   641	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   642	  });
   643	
   644	  const heroScale = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   645	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   646	    outputRange: [heroStartScale, heroScaleAtMinimumOpacity],
   647	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   648	  });
   649	
   650	  const heroTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   651	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   652	    outputRange: [heroStartTranslateY, heroTranslateYAtMinimumOpacity],
   653	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   654	  });
   655	
   656	  const headerTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   657	    inputRange: [0, 120],
   658	    outputRange: [0, -120],
   659	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   660	  });
   661	
   662	  const indicatorSegmentWidth = windowWidth / navPages.length;
   663	  const indicatorTranslateX = Animated.multiply(
   664	    indicatorProgress,
   665	    indicatorSegmentWidth
   666	  );
   667	  const isMainHeroPage = navPages.includes(resolvedActivePage);
   668	  const heroImageSource = isMainHeroPage
   669	    ? noCheeseboardHeroImage
   670	    : defaultHeroImage;
   671	  const mainHeroVisualOpacity = isMainHeroPage
   672	    ? resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   673	        inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   674	        outputRange: [1, heroMinimumScrollOpacity],
   675	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   676	      })
   677	    : 1;
   678	  const heroWidthFitScale = windowWidth / heroSourceWidth;
   679	  const heroWidthFitImageHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroWidthFitScale;
   680	  const heroImageFrameStyle = isMainHeroPage
   681	    ? {
   682	        width: windowWidth,
   683	        height: heroWidthFitImageHeight,
   684	      }
   685	    : null;
   686	  const heroImageTransformStyle = isMainHeroPage
   687	    ? null
   688	    : {
   689	        transform: [{ scale: heroScale }, { translateY: heroTranslateY }],
   690	      };
   691	  const heroImageOpacityStyle = isMainHeroPage
   692	    ? { opacity: mainHeroVisualOpacity }
   693	    : null;
   694	  const heroCoverScale = Math.max(
   695	    windowWidth / heroSourceWidth,
   696	    heroVerticalFadeHeight / heroSourceHeight
   697	  );
   698	  const heroLayoutScale = isMainHeroPage ? heroWidthFitScale : heroCoverScale;
   699	  const heroRenderedWidth = heroSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   700	  const heroRenderedHeight = heroSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   701	  const heroRenderedLeft = (windowWidth - heroRenderedWidth) / 2;
   702	  const heroRenderedTop = isMainHeroPage
   703	    ? 0
   704	    : (heroVerticalFadeHeight - heroRenderedHeight) / 2;
   705	  const noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY = Math.min(
   706	    heroVerticalFadeHeight,
   707	    heroRenderedTop + noCheeseboardVisibleBottomSourceY * heroLayoutScale
   708	  );
   709	  const cheeseboardWidth = cheeseboardSourceWidth * heroLayoutScale;
   710	  const cheeseboardHeight = cheeseboardSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   711	  const cheeseboardLeft =
   712	    heroRenderedLeft + cheeseboardSourceX * heroLayoutScale;
   713	  const cheeseboardTop = isMainHeroPage
   714	    ? noCheeseboardVisibleBottomY - cheeseboardHeight / 2
   715	    : heroRenderedTop + cheeseboardSourceY * heroLayoutScale;

   717	  const isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled =
   718	    isMainHeroPage && isHeaderNewState(resolvedHeroMotionScrollY);
   719	  const isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive =
   720	    isMainHeroPage &&
   721	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   722	    Boolean(routeTransitionState?.isActive);

   724	    isMainHeroPage &&
   725	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   726	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive);

   728	    routeTransitionState?.direction === -1 ? -1 : 1;
   729	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartX =
   730	    typeof routeTransitionState?.startX === "number"
   731	      ? routeTransitionState.startX
   732	      : 0;
   733	  const cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX =
   734	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.01 : 0;
   735	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX =
   736	    Math.abs(cheeseboardTransitionStartX) > 0.01
   737	      ? cheeseboardTransitionStartX
   738	      : cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX;

   740	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.001 : 0;
   741	  const cheeseboardDragTranslateX = isCheeseboardSwipeActive
   742	    ? screenSwipe?.swipeX || 0
   743	    : 0;
   744	  const cheeseboardBaseTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   745	    ? 0
   746	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   747	  const cheeseboardBaseOpacity = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   748	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   749	        inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   750	        outputRange: [
   751	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   752	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   753	          1,
   754	        ],
   755	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   756	      })
   757	    : 1;
   758	  const cheeseboardOutgoingTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   759	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   760	        inputRange: [0, 1],
   761	        outputRange: [
   762	          cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX,
   763	          -cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   764	        ],
   765	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   766	      })
   767	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   768	  const cheeseboardIncomingTranslateX = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   769	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   770	    outputRange: [
   771	      cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX +
   772	        cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   773	      cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX,
   774	    ],
   775	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   776	  });
   777	  const cheeseboardIncomingOpacity = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   778	    inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   779	    outputRange: [1, 1, 0],
   780	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   781	  });
   782	  const cheeseboardPreviousPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   783	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, -windowWidth)
   784	    : -windowWidth;
   785	  const cheeseboardNextPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   786	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, windowWidth)
   787	    : windowWidth;
   788	  const shouldShowCheeseboardDragPreviews =
   789	    isMainHeroPage &&
   790	    isCheeseboardSwipeActive &&
   791	    !isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive;
   792	  const handleCarouselTouchStart = (event) => {
   793	    showHeldArrows(event);
   794	    return false;
   795	  };
   796	
   797	  const sharedHeaderTouchHandlers = {
   798	    onStartShouldSetResponderCapture: handleCarouselTouchStart,
   799	    onTouchStart: showHeldArrows,
   800	    onTouchMove: updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove,
   801	    onTouchEnd: hideHeldArrows,
   802	    onTouchCancel: hideHeldArrows,
   803	  };
   804	
   805	  const renderArrowChevron = (direction) => (
   806	    <View
   807	      style={[
   808	        styles.arrowChevron,
   809	        direction === "left"
   810	          ? styles.arrowChevronLeft
   811	          : styles.arrowChevronRight,
   812	      ]}
   813	    />
   814	  );
   815

   817	    const slideTransformStyle =
   818	      translateX === 0 ? null : { transform: [{ translateX }] };
   819	    const resolvedSlideOpacity =
   820	      isMainHeroPage && opacity !== 1
   821	        ? Animated.multiply(opacity, mainHeroVisualOpacity)

   823	        ? mainHeroVisualOpacity
   824	        : opacity;
   825	    const slideOpacityStyle =
   826	      resolvedSlideOpacity === 1 ? null : { opacity: resolvedSlideOpacity };
   827	
   828	    return (
   829	      <Animated.View
   830	        key={key}
   831	        collapsable={false}
   832	        pointerEvents="none"
   833	        renderToHardwareTextureAndroid
   834	        style={[
   835	          styles.cheeseboardSlideLayer,
   836	          slideTransformStyle,
   837	          slideOpacityStyle,
   838	        ]}
   839	      >
   840	        <Animated.View
   841	          collapsable={false}
   842	          style={styles.cheeseboardHeroTransformLayer}
   843	        >
   844	          <Animated.View
   845	            collapsable={false}
   846	            renderToHardwareTextureAndroid
   847	            style={[
   848	              styles.cheeseboardProductsFrame,
   849	              {
   850	                left: cheeseboardLeft,
   851	                top: cheeseboardTop,
   852	                width: cheeseboardWidth,
   853	                height: cheeseboardHeight,
   854	                transform: [{ scale: heroScale }],
   855	              },
   856	            ]}
   857	          >
   858	            <Image
   859	              fadeDuration={0}
   860	              source={cheeseboardProductsImage}
   861	              style={styles.cheeseboardProductsImage}
   862	              resizeMode="contain"
   863	            />
   864	          </Animated.View>
   865	        </Animated.View>
   866	      </Animated.View>

   868	  };
   869	
   870	  const carousel = (
   871	    <View
   872	      style={styles.carouselShell}
   873	      {...carouselPanResponder.panHandlers}
   874	      {...sharedHeaderTouchHandlers}
   875	    >

   877	        <View style={styles.carouselStickyExpansion}>
   878	          <Animated.View
   879	            pointerEvents="none"
   880	            style={[
   881	              styles.carouselStickyExpansionFill,

   884	              },
   885	            ]}

   890	          style={[

     1	import { Animated } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	import sharedStyles from "../styles/sharedStyles";
     4	
     5	const topDividerFadeScrollDistance = 240;
     6	
     7	export default function PageDivider({
     8	  expandedSpacing = false,
     9	  fadeScrollDistance = topDividerFadeScrollDistance,
    10	  fadeWithScrollY = null,
    11	}) {
    12	  const fadeOpacity = fadeWithScrollY?.interpolate({
    13	    inputRange: [0, fadeScrollDistance],
    14	    outputRange: [1, 0],
    15	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    16	  });
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <Animated.View
    20	      style={[
    21	        sharedStyles.pageDivider,
    22	        expandedSpacing && sharedStyles.expandedPageDivider,
    23	        fadeOpacity && { opacity: fadeOpacity },
    24	      ]}
    25	    />
    26	  );
    27	}

FILE: mob/utils/headerScrollContext.js
============================================================

     1	import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
     2	
     3	const HeaderScrollContext = createContext(null);
     4	
     5	export function HeaderScrollProvider({ children, scrollY }) {
     6	  return (
     7	    <HeaderScrollContext.Provider value={scrollY}>
     8	      {children}
     9	    </HeaderScrollContext.Provider>
    10	  );
    11	}
    12	
    13	export function useHeaderScrollY() {
    14	  return useContext(HeaderScrollContext);
    15	}

============================================================
FILE: mob/utils/openPaymentLink.js
============================================================

     1	import { Alert, Linking, Platform } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	export async function openPaymentLink(url) {
     4	  if (!url) {
     5	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
     6	      window.alert("No payment link has been added for this product yet.");
     7	      return;
     8	    }
     9	
    10	    Alert.alert("Payment link missing", "No payment link has been added yet.");
    11	    return;
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  try {
    15	    const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(url);
    16	
    17	    if (!canOpen) {
    18	      throw new Error("Cannot open URL");
    19	    }
    20	
    21	    await Linking.openURL(url);
    22	  } catch (error) {
    23	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    24	      window.alert("Unable to open this payment link.");
    25	      return;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    Alert.alert("Unable to open link", "Please try again later.");
    29	  }
    30	}
